mapper.select: SELECT A.DEPTNO, A.PARENT_DEPT_NO, A.DEPTNAME FROM ( SELECT D.DEPTNO, D.PARENT_DEPT_NO, NVL(GET_DEPT_NAME(D.DEPTID, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), D.DEPTNO) AS DEPTNAME, D.DEPT_LEVEL, D.ORDERNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE (D.DATE_ENDED IS NULL OR (D.DATE_CREATED < SYSDATE AND D.DATE_ENDED > SYSDATE)) AND D.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH D.PARENT_DEPT_NO = '0' AND D.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO ) A ORDER BY A.DEPT_LEVEL, A.ORDERNO, A.DEPTNO
